text:
alex: FYI pushed runtime 2.15.0 to canary ~10:02Z. Deploybot auto-applied a soft-pin to runtime for llama3q on eu-west after rollout. Seeing a small spike in kv-cache OOMs (nonfatal) and p50 latency +15ms. Thoughts on holding the pin?

deploybot: Deployment note: runtime-2.15.0 -> canary started 2026-03-23T10:02Z. Pin scope: cohort=canary, models=llama3q. Pin type: soft. Monitor tags: kv-cache, longseq. Link: https://deploy.redwood/6124591111 :robot_face:

morgan: :eyes: can you paste the OOM sample logs? how many instances?

alex: quick paste of logs: ```
[10:05:12] instance i-09ab... kv_cache_alloc failed 3x in 5s
[10:05:45] instance i-0f3c... slow path fallback -> quant kernel
```
2 instances showing repeat allocations, overall error rate still <0.5% of canary requests.

jia: Telemetry dashboard -> https://telemetry.redwood/r/llama3q/rollouts shows error rate trending 0.3 -> 0.6% over 10m; tail latency rising on longseq. SDK client compatibility note: sdk-js 3.8.1 includes a header for kv-cache hint that runtime 2.15 uses. Not required but helps routing.

ops-sre: If it's nonfatal and <1% we can keep soft-pin but enable fallback routing to runtime-2.14 for requests with sequence_len>1024. Recommend patching routing policy: ```json
{"route": [{"if": "seq>1024","to": "runtime-2.14"},{"else":"runtime-2.15"}], "weight": {"runtime-2.14": 0.0, "runtime-2.15": 1.0}}
```
I can push a temporary route change to the canary traffic tier.

morgan: agree with fallback. Also reduce max_batch_tokens to 512 for canary pods to lower memory pressure.

alex: +1 to both. Sam, can you update release notes and call out the kv-cache behavior so customers on Dedicated/Private know to watch longseq?

sam: On it. I'll add an entry to the 2.15.0 release notes: "kv-cache allocation improvements; known regressions: rare OOM on longseq workloads — follow fallback routing and SDK 3.8.1 for mitigation." Also emailing accounts with Dedicated capacity in eu-west.

jia: Quick compatibility checklist: runtime-2.15 uses new kernel shims -> models quant-v3b tested OK. SDK 3.8.1 adds hint header. Recommend adding a short migration note in console and an eval run for customer-facing prompt sets.

deploybot: Applied temp-route: seq>1024 -> runtime-2.14 for cohort=canary at 10:17Z. Adjusted canary pod batch tokens -> 512. Will revert when safe.

ops-sre: Monitoring alert updated: if kv-cache OOM rate > 1.5% over 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms -> automatic rollback to runtime-2.14 across canary and pause pin. Hooking into deploybot rollback.

morgan: If rollback happens, what's the rollback window and communication plan?

alex: Rollback window immediate, ops team initiates rollback and posts here + #incidents. Sam will draft a short customer note if rollback extends >30m.

jia: Small test request: I'll run our longseq perf suite against a canary pod at 10:25Z and paste results.

alex: Plan summary: 1) keep soft-pin for 1h 2) fallback routing for seq>1024 to 2.14 applied 3) reduce batch tokens to 512 4) monitor thresholds (ops-sre) 5) sam updates release notes + customer notif. If alarms fire -> rollback automated + manual comms. :thumbsup:

morgan: :thumbsup: monitoring looks green aside from the small bump, will stay on watch.

jia: perf run done: longseq median latency up 12%, p95 up 22% on canary pod; no new OOMs in 10m after routing change. Posting artifact link: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/6124591111.

alex: OK closing loop. We'll wait 1h for stability signal. If stable, remove soft-pin after roll window and announce in eng-releases. Thanks all. :rocket:
